judgement.reason: Temporal server is a gRPC workflow orchestration server that SDK clients and workers connect to, not a web application serving HTTP on one port, and the Dockerfile copies a prebuilt binary rather than building this source.

evidence.quote: The Temporal server executes units of application logic called Workflows in a resilient manner that automatically handles intermittent failures, and retries failed operations.
This repository contains the source code of the Temporal server. To implement Workflows, Activities and Workers, use one of the [supported languages](https://docs.temporal.io/dev-guide/).
